# apple_app_categories (Data Source)

Lists the App Store categories and subcategories, for `apple_app_info`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_categories" "ios" {
  platforms = ["IOS"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `platforms` (Set of String) Only categories available on one of these platforms. Values: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (Attributes List) The categories, then their subcategories, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--categories))

<a id="nestedatt--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `categories`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) ID of the category, e.g. `GAMES` or `GAMES_PUZZLE`.
- `parent_id` (String) ID of the parent category, for subcategories.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms the category is available on.
